## Verification checklist

<!-- Every point must be Yes for a proposal. If any point is No, say so below and file this as a failed verification instead. -->
- [ ] Repo exists (not 404)
- [ ] Has a SKILL.md (root, skills/, or .claude/skills/)
- [ ] Licence is clear: <!-- write the type -->
- [ ] Free ($0) — no mandatory payment for basic functions
- [ ] Does not read `.env` or the vault
- [ ] No harmful instructions
- [ ] Does not ask for secrets in files, logs, or chat
- [ ] Description is honest — matches the SKILL.md
